computes the per-pixel YUV key exactly as the 2^24-entry rgbtoyuv table of init
interpolates whole 32-bit words, alpha included, with edge replication into owned tight planes
refuses formats, budgets, malformed strides, bad time bases and cancellation explicitly
plans n-times geometry on every path, converts other sources to bgra, keeps the timed sample aspect ratio and bounds the scaled output
runs against the sandbox-built native reference at 946fcce0 configured with --disable-x86asm
matches native hq2x, hq3x and hq4x pixels on bgra across sizes, structured patterns and noise with default and single filter threads
matches native linear and graph hqx plans with scalar conversions from rgba, rgb24 and other packed and gray sources
matches native replayed hqx streams with branches and joins frame by frame
matches native hqx CLI rawvideo and framecrc with and without -ss/-t on the linear, graph, actor and timed paths
negotiates every accepted source to bgra as native does, byte-exact on every path
refuses hqx output above maxFrameBytes and options native rejects or scopes out before any output is opened

details.compares: kernel output bytes per frame vs native -vf hqx=n=N on bgra (36 native runs)
native default filter threads vs -filter_threads 1 outputs (all equal)
rawvideo bytes, native -cpuflags 0 -vf vs compileVideoFilterChain and compileVideoFilterGraph (96 cases x 2 planners)
rawvideo bytes and pts, native -filter_complex vs createReplayVideoExecution
complete rawvideo and framecrc CLI outputs, with and without -ss/-t, on media -vf/-filter_complex and timed producer/activation/pull
per-source negotiation: native showinfo pick and rawvideo bytes on every path for 17 sources
native option acceptance/rejection, with our refusal before output

unsupported: expression-valued or non-decimal n (n=2+1, n=0x2, n=4.0; native accepts them)
enable= (native has no timeline either), generic filter-context options such as threads
big-endian hosts (RGB32 is argb there); refused in hqxGeometry
H.264/MP4 framecrc input was not compared (uniform scale, linear path shared)

notes: No shared edit beyond the two registry lines was needed.
All cases are integer and run on every platform; no linux-x64 gate.
The 2^24-entry rgbtoyuv table is replaced by hqxRgbToYuv, checked against a replay of the native init walk over all 16,777,216 colours in the unit test.
Mutation check: removing 'actor' (or 'timed') from the descriptor paths makes the CLI test fail on the producer (or pull) scheduler.
Kernel errors are VideoHqxError, parse errors VideoFilterParseError; packages/avfilter/src/index.ts was not edited, so the kernel functions are reachable from the module but not the public barrel.

Environment: sandbox Node was v22.23.5 (bootstrap needs 24); used the preinstalled /opt/node24 (v24.22.3). Native hqx init costs about 0.3 s per run (64 MiB table), which bounds the differential case counts.
Setup durations: bootstrap (npm 10.0 s, submodule 7.2 s, reference build about 200 s) 217 s total; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 59 s; baseline video-operator-registry unit 2 s (8 passed).
Differential file runtime about 100 s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
